title: Tell agents to record lessons in the module 3md file
description: Tell agents to record lessons in the module 3md file
acceptance_criteria: Agents are told to record a new lesson on a later plane of module.3md when that file exists.
Each module spec changelog records that the 3md file is beside the spec.

answers.constraints: When module.3md exists and parses, it is the lesson source. context.md stays, and new lessons go on a later plane.
